newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ANALYSTS' COMMENTS ON PHILIPS Q4 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: ANALYSTS' COMMENTS ON PHILIPS Q4 RESULTS.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it made a fourth quarter net loss from normal operations of 81 million guilders versus a profit of 1.02 billion guilders in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Analysts had expected Philips to report fourth quarter net profit from normal operations of 387-750 million guilders, with consensus around 526 million.
Below is a collection of analysts' comments on the results.

"The figures were not as good as expected, but not terribly disappointing. It is a good idea Philips is taking all the charges now... 1997 will probably still be tough, but in 1998 the effects of all the restructuring should start working out for Philips. It is a good signal to investors that Philips is paying out a dividend over 1996 and particularly that it has not lowered the dividend. Investors will see this as a gesture that Philips will do better in the future."

"The level of restructuring charges could have been worse... The achievement of a positive cash flow of over one billion guilders in 1997 does not sound unrealistic. Turnover for the semiconductor unit was higher than expected and the profit was in line with what we had expected. This could mean that (semiconductor) profits will increase as the margin improves. We are sticking to our hold recommendation for the stock, although the unchanged dividend of 1.60 guilders per share was good news. But that is not enough to upgrade the stock. The Philips share price will probably remain volatile..."
